content_sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MNNIT Allahabad Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Part-Time Coaches / Trainers: Graduate in any discipline / Diploma or Certificate Course in respective sports/Yoga/Gym and At least two years coaching/training experience (Minimum 2 years experience).

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: Not Specified Maximum Age: Not Specified

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MNNIT Allahabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) for hiring Part-Time Coaches and Trainers.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for various sports coaches, gym trainers, and yoga instructors under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the selection mode for MNNIT Allahabad Part-Time Coaches posts?
faq.answer: The selection will be done purely through a Walk-in-Interview conducted by the Selection Committee at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the Walk-in-Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in-Interview is scheduled to take place on 09 October 2026 starting from 09:30 A.M. onwards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an all-inclusive consolidated salary of ₹ 15,000/- per month for their respective part-time roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates applying or attending the walk-in interview across all categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline along with a diploma or certificate course in coaching and at least 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in-Interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Executive Development Centre (EDC), Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any prior online application required?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to fill the application form through the online link https://mnnitnt.samarth.edu.in/ and bring its printed copy along with enclosures to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for MNNIT Allahabad Part-Time Coaches?
faq.answer: The offered positions are strictly on a contract/part-time basis for training and coaching students in various sports and physical activities.
